g.text: AiSPRY Technologies • Indian Railways • 5-Stage Operational Architecture (WDD • Locate • Railcomm)
THE 3 PRODUCTION AI PLATFORMS (STAGE 01: CAPTURE ➔ STAGE 02: INFER ➔ STAGE 03: ATTRIBUTE)
Body, Door, Bogie, Coupler, Spring, Handrail, Ladder
KPI: 5-8h review reduced to ~2h • 99.2% frame detection • 98% OCR
Mobile Phone, Sleep/Fatigue, Food, Hand Signal, Unauth
Walkie-Talkie, Reading/Writing, Train Control (No False Alarm)
Rule: Every alert has Reviewer Verification Queue (Pending vs Confirmed)
Operational VHF / Tetra Radio & Intercom Streams
Caution, Stop, Signal, Block, Line Clear, BP Pressure
SAFETY RULE: FAIL-OPEN (AI stall never blocks original voice channel)
PLUGGABLE DATA BACKEND & STORAGE ADAPTERS (MODULAR / CLOUD-AGNOSTIC)
ADAPTER A: ON-PREMISE / AIR-GAPPED (RAILWAY DATA CENTER PRIORITY)
• PostgreSQL: Roster, train schedules, audit trails, and reviewer decisions.
• MongoDB: High-volume telemetry detections, bounding boxes, and event payloads.
• pgvector / Qdrant & MinIO: On-prem semantic vector search & object media store.
ADAPTER B: CLOUD DEPLOYMENT (GOOGLE CLOUD ADAPTER FOR BUILDATHON)
• Google Cloud Storage (GCS): Cloud object store for audio WAVs and video MP4 clips.
• BigQuery + Vector Search: Managed serverless vector indexing over 3.68M lines.
• Cloud Run / Vertex AI: Managed container serving & Gemini API gateway.
RAILKAVACH COPILOT: CONVERSATIONAL REASONING CORE & AGENT SKILLS
Pluggable Reasoning: Gemini 1.5 Pro (Cloud) ⇋ Gemma Edge (On-Prem)
Guarantees 100% demo uptime at Buildathon. Pre-validated grounded answers serve in <150ms even if venue Wi-Fi stutters.
STAGE 04: SURFACE (UNIFIED DASHBOARD) & STAGE 05: EVIDENCE MANAGEMENT (AUDIT & GOVERNANCE)
Trains processed, wagons inspected, active journeys, verified violations, channel quality.
Natural language Q&A in English & Hindi; synchronized audio/video timeline cards.
Safety officers review evidence clips; records reviewer ID, timestamp & decision.
Ready-to-sign formal CRS Inquiry Reports & Devanagari Hindi sign-on warning slips.
AiSPRY Technologies • Startup Buildathon India 2026 • Platform: RailKavach (WDD • Locate • Railcomm) & RailKavach Copilot
